paragraphs: I'm part of BPCL's **USD 184.84M refrigerated LPG import terminal expansion**, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering and mechanical construction to take the terminal from **1.2 to 3.0 MMTPA**. That covers equipment installation, hydrostatic and pneumatic testing, instrument hot-loop testing, and pre-commissioning for the cryogenic facilities, all in line with **OISD standards** and project schedules.

I also manage the railway overbridge work: design, statutory approvals, fabrication, installation, testing, and pre-commissioning of a **USD 3.11M package**, with coordination covering **four railway overbridges** across Indian Railways, Central Railways, consultants, contractors, and BPCL stakeholders.

In the manufacturing division at Bajaj Auto I studied assembly-line workflow and task sequencing across four motorcycle models, using time studies and line balancing to find the bottlenecks. By redistributing 9.25 minutes of work content across four conveyor systems, throughput went from **360 to 546 vehicles per shift, a 51% improvement**.

patents.title: An automated ergonogauge device for measuring three-dimensional spatial data
patents.note: ErgonoGauge: an automated system for measuring the 3D orientation of the occlusal plane, combining an adjustable mechanical structure with BNO055 orientation sensors, Arduino-based data acquisition, and a graphical interface reporting pitch, roll, and yaw.

patents.title: Orthodontic appliances to prevent tongue-thrusting habit
patents.note: DynaThrust: a compact orthodontic device that gives feedback against tongue thrust through a compliant mechanism — a deformable elastomeric element with 3D-printed structure — with its mechanical response evaluated in simulation.

about: Mechanical engineer by degree. Electronics nerd by minor. Builder by habit. At NIT Karnataka I learned to design the frame, lay out the board, and write the code for the same machine.
Qualified for ABU Robocon nationals three years running. Co-founded NITK's first combat robotics team and built a 4WD 15 kg bot with a vertical bar spinner. Led 40 people as Vice-Captain.
Two patents filed with Dr. Khyati Verma, both in assistive and biomedical devices. And a day job at BPCL, where a USD 184.84M LPG terminal is growing from 1.2 to 3.0 MMTPA and I get to help build it.
heroTagline: I'm a different breed of creator: I can't stop at the idea. Give me a blank page and a problem, and I'll build you the answer. Robowars arenas, Robocon fields, cryogenic LPG terminals. The settings change; the thrill doesn't.
